[RARC.3.3.4] The upward-only rule ([LTIE.3.1]) holds in either case as
long as the integrator's bridge carries facts upward only. What crosses is a
schema name and slot values ([NCBK.10.1]): the receiving tier's own schema
decides the fact's lifecycle and TTL ([LTIE.9.4]), and truth maintenance does
not cross ([LTIE.4.6.2]). The runtime does not enforce cross-tier semantics —
they are the integrator's to maintain across their transport.
